title: Freestanding paper towel holder 18-Inch Solid Brass Weighted Base Traditional | classic bath accessories | Allied Brass
description:
Keep your space neat with a freestanding paper towel holder that adds a traditional, refined look. Crafted from solid brass, this 18-Inch countertop paper towel stand uses a weighted base to help prevent tipping and a felt pad to help protect surfaces. A strong fit for traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures styling—while also finishing a kitchen counter with a coordinated look.

Highlights:
- Freestanding (no wall mount) countertop paper towel holder / paper towel stand
- Crafted from the finest solid brass materials
- Solid brass weighted base helps prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs:
- Material: Brass
- Style: Traditional
- Dimensions: 5.5-Inch L x 5.5-Inch W x 18-Inch H
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included item: Paper towel holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
